views.label: Admission
views.note: Every path but the named public ones is verified before a handler runs.

views.label: Authorisation
views.note: The grant check and the body schema both run before the transaction opens.

views.label: Tenant transaction
views.note: The row and the audit entry share one transaction, then the response is redacted.

messages.label: POST /api/v1/invoices + Bearer
messages.note: Rate limit is keyed on orgId:ip, so one branch behind a NAT cannot exhaust the tenant budget.

messages.label: principal: org, branch, role, scope
messages.note: 401 when the token is missing, expired or invalid. scope is derived from the role, never read from the token.

messages.label: dispatch, then parse body
messages.note: orgId, version and createdBy are refused rather than stripped; a schema failure answers 400.

messages.label: granted, else 403
messages.note: Server and client read the same RBAC matrix; the test suite asserts the two tables are identical.

messages.label: BEGIN + set_config app.org_id
messages.note: The RLS policies read app.org_id, app.branch_id, app.user_id and app.scope.

messages.label: INSERT ... RETURNING
messages.note: Writer rules that must read other rows run here, inside the same transaction as the write.

messages.label: INSERT audit_log, same tx
messages.note: Append-only at the database level; password hashes and tokens are scrubbed before the row is written.

messages.label: present, then redact fields
messages.note: A field the role may not see is nulled before serialisation, so it never reaches the wire.

messages.label: 201 + x-request-id
messages.note: The onSend hook stamps x-request-id on every reply, including the error envelopes.

cards.title: Authenticated by default
items: The hook covers everything except /health, /ready, /api/v1/public/leads and the login routes
A route added later is verified unless it is explicitly named public
There is no development bypass header: a test signs a real token

cards.title: Isolation is the database's job
items: Every query runs in a transaction that has already set app.org_id
A handler that forgets WHERE org_id still cannot read another tenant
Redaction happens on the way out, not in the client

cards.title: One error contract
items: A rule or permission failure is logged at warn with no stack trace
23505 answers 409 and names the colliding field from the index name
Anything unrecognised is 500 with a request id and no driver message
